population.rule: the ADMITTED set is the GIT-TRACKED set: per-checkout `git ls-files -z` under the corpus root, the router's extension list, present in the working tree, <= 1 MiB; PATHS and DISTINCT are the on-disk walk (symlinked directories followed and counted)
population.guard: filesAdmitted === filesRead AND parseFailed === 0 AND readFailed === 0, else exit 6 (the cpp lane's leaked-tree form)

decorates.ruling: ONTOLOGICAL (Lead, 2026-10-23) — a Nim pragma is a compiler directive; an annotation is passive metadata and a decorator is an applied callable (src/ast/types.ts:131-144; VOCABULARY-EXTENSION-PROPOSAL §3)

falsifier.class: an APPLIED CALLABLE in a pragma position
falsifier.wouldFail: THIS RULING IS REFUTED IF the applied-callable class is the decorates construct: the census counts every pragma site whose name resolves to a declared pragma template (`template/macro X() {.pragma.}`), and a non-zero count is the discriminator — the count is published above and in the declaration so the claim is checkable rather than asserted. A SECOND half: any grammar node type for an @-decorator application (none in the served inventory).

part_of.decision: 1:1 RELABEL of imports->part_of for include_statement rows, KEEPING the analyzer's normalized module-name target with metadata.targetResolution = module-name and metadata.partRole = library; the divergence from fsharp/php (which emit project-relative paths) is RECORDED, never flattened

mixes_in.rulingShape: mixin names SYMBOLS open for overload resolution; it composes no type into a supertype chain and declares no conformance

renders.rulingShape: Nim has no grammar-level rendering construct; rendering is a macro DSL over ordinary call nodes, so no position in a render-host call can name a COMPONENT TYPE

falsifier.class: a render-host call whose argument or explicit type argument names a CONCRETE COMPONENT TYPE
falsifier.wouldFail: THIS RULING IS REFUTED IF any render-host-shaped call in the admitted population carries an argument that names a declared type used as a component — the census counts the render-host calls and classifies every argument, so the falsifier is a number in this file (measured: 0). The grammar half is validation/m14/measurements/nim-grammar-nodes.json (the served build's own named node types, 0 render/component families).
